### The Lord’s Supper and Proclamation
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/lords-supper-and-proclamation
Passage: 1 Corinthians 11:26
Points:
- God ordained that the gospel be proclaimed not only through spoken words, but also through tangible elements.
- The broken bread and poured wine physically depict the body and blood of Jesus given on the cross.
- Celebrating the Lord’s Supper is a perpetual ordinance for believers until Christ returns in glory.
- Eating and drinking in faith publicly testifies that Christ's redeeming death has personally saved us.

### Worthy Partaking: Examining the Heart
Author: Tom Ascol
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/worthy-partaking-examining-heart
Passage: 1 Corinthians 11:27-29
Points:
- The Lord’s Supper is a sacred command that must never be treated as a casual or mechanical routine.
- Communing unworthily involves taking the bread and cup without reverent regard for Christ’s sacrifice.
- Worthiness does not require sinless perfection, but rather genuine repentance and reliance on the Savior.
- Honest self-examination is intended as preparation to receive grace, not a barrier to keep believers away.

### Discerning the Body
Author: Keith Mathison
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/discerning-body
Passage: 1 Corinthians 11:17-34
Points:
- Paul confronted the Corinthian church because their social cliques and neglect of the poor disgraced the Lord's Supper.
- Partaking in remembrance is an active confession that unifies the church across social and economic lines.
- Failing to discern the Lord's body includes despising fellow believers who belong to that same body.
- Believers must examine their hearts and conduct so their communal worship leads to blessing instead of judgment.
